name: "Decorate Your Own" Stuffed Eggs with Veggie Designs (Cooking with Kids)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe contains steps that can be done by smaller hands! You know your child (and their cooking abilities) best, so get them involved where you feel comfortable. Have fun!

Place water in a 6-quart multicooker, then add the metal trivet. Arrange eggs on the trivet in an even layer, then lock lid and set to pressure cook on HIGH for 7 minutes. Once done, manually release the pressure. (Alternatively, you can cook the eggs in a saucepan or use store-bought peeled, hard-cooked eggs.)
Meanwhile, fill a medium bowl halfway with cold water (from the tap) and add 12 ice cubes, creating an ice bath.
Use a slotted spoon or tongs to add cooked eggs to the ice bath. Set aside to cool completely, about 15 minutes.

TO MAKE YOUR DECORATIONS: While the eggs are cooling, wash and dry the fresh produce. (You will be assembling a variety of things to use to decorate your finished eggs. Think hair, eyes, arms, flower petals - the possibilities are endless!)
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
½ cup sugar snap peas
1 medium carrot
1 red bell pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pick small bunches of leaves off the parsley and place on a plate.
Halve and/or thinly slice snap peas crosswise. Add to the plate with the parsley.

Peel and trim carrot. Trim and seed bell pepper. Cut a variety of shapes from the two veggies (strips, squares, triangles). You can also use a grater to shred part of the carrot. Add all your shapes to the plate, along with drained olives, and set aside.
When the eggs have finished cooling, have some fun cracking and peeling them!
Halve eggs lengthwise, then scoop out the yolks and place in a small bowl. Add mayo, Dijon, salt, and pepper, then using a fork, mash to combine, creating a smooth paste.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp mayonnaise
½ tsp Dijon mustard
⅛ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Spoon the yolk mixture back into the eggs. Using your decorations, create faces, egg-people, bugs, flowers, or monster eyes - use your imagination and have fun!
Arrange decorated eggs on a platter, share, and enjoy!
